description: Words into Music is an AI song-generation service that lets users create and manage songs from prompts or lyrics. Its MCP server allows compatible assistants to check account usage, prepare songs, start generation, and read song/job details in the user's private library.
summary: Words into Music exposes one OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://mcp.wordsintomusic.com/mcp`, using self-onboarding OAuth with dynamic client registration.
